searchText: Hello Guys. I have question about call_tracer in the geth source code. Please see code from the call_tracer_legacy.js. ``` if (log.getDepth() == this.callstack.length - 1) { // Pop off the last call and get the execution results var call = this.callstack.pop(); if (call.type == 'CREATE' || call.type == "CREATE2") { // If the call was a CREATE, retrieve the contract address and output code call.gasUsed = '0x' + bigInt(call.gasIn - call.gasCost - log.getGas()).toString(16); delete call.gasIn; delete call.gasCost; var ret = log.stack.peek(0); if (!ret.equals(0)) { call.to = toHex(toAddress(ret.toString(16))); call.output = toHex(db.getCode(toAddress(ret.toString(16)))); } else if (call.error === undefined) { call.error = "internal failure"; // TODO(karalabe): surface these faults somehow } ``` I don't get it where this `log.getGas()` function. Anyone Please guide me?? OK My geth version is v1.9.10. those came from `tracer.go` . Then other question. What is `__4byte_tracerJs` for? Here is again answer from by myself. It's go-binddata result. Now I got it . Thank you
